extraction.Name: Susie Dixon—nee Sears
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment, which is about 19 acres less than 160, at the time she received it, as she did not want to pay the taxes; but that she was advised by the Indian Agency that, if she did not take it, it would be put on record, the land taxed, and she would finally lose the land through these taxes, so she took it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in September, 1918, she sold it to her father-in-law, John Dixon, for $1500.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: her husband was owing his father for some cattle, and they sold him this land to pay off this debt
extraction.Occupation/Income: her husband supports the family by common labor, when or whereever he can get it; and that is all the income they have
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; has pretty fair health; mother of 9 children, all having pretty good health; husband has good health; she considers that they got a fair price for her land; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; allotment is about 19 acres less than 160 acres
